links.comparator_used: Native LLM safeguard responses (the LLM's own built-in safety behavior) to suicide-related vignettes
links.outcome: Detection of suicide risk requiring intervention across 224 paired vignette evaluations
links.effect: Supervisory system detected risk in 205/224 (91.5%) vs 41/224 (18.3%) for native LLM safeguards; of 168 discordant evaluations, 166 favored the supervisory system and 2 favored the LLM (matched OR ≈83.0); both detected in 39, neither in 17
links.quote: The supervisory system detected suicide risk in 205 of 224 evaluations (91.5%) versus 41 of 224 (18.3%) for native LLM safeguards.

design_hint: independent supervisory safety agent for suicide risk detection
